name: Portlight - a new captain's first season (local seats)
persona: You are a new captain in the Mediterranean trade. You have a small ship, a little silver and a hold to fill, and you want to turn it into a name and a fortune in the ports along this coast. Play the way a careful merchant would: look before you commit, and notice what each port is willing to pay.

criteria.check: Prices at a port change after the player buys or sells goods there.
The player can sail from the starting port and arrive at a second port.
A choice the player makes visibly spends a resource shown on screen, such as silver, provisions, hull or crew.
The game tells the player what they are trying to achieve.
On every turn the player has at least one action that moves the game forward.
